title: AstroDSB_SupRes: Diffusion Schrodinger Bridge super-resolution code (0910 model)
description:
Training and inference code of the Astro-DSB super-resolution model (0910 configuration, the model used in the paper): data loader with the degradation model, bridge diffusion, network, sliding-window inference with Hann blending. Trained weights, analysis scripts and the released maps are in a separate Zenodo record, linked under related works and cited in the paper.

This repository is for the paper Astro-DSB: Physics-Informed Generative Super-Resolution for Astronomical Imaging Surveys by Duo Xu. It is associated with the manuscript number AAS81737.
